scope.summary: Implement Package: collect the document, its linked resources, and its fonts (subject to font-licensing) into a portable folder with a report, for handoff to a printer or archive. Package MUST operate over a book (MT-172) as well as a single document. Dispatched as a StudioExportRecipe through the quiet/headless output path (MT-181); reuses the link record (MT-163).
acceptance_criteria: package collects document/links/fonts + report over single document and book
expected_tests: live: package collects document + linked resources + fonts into a portable folder with a report (single document)
test: package operates over a book across chapter documents

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Package for output

risk_if_missed: No printer/archive handoff; documents cannot be moved with their assets and fonts.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
